title: The Lake That Swallowed an Entire Village
description: In 1986, Lake Nyos in Cameroon released a massive cloud of carbon dioxide that killed people and animals nearby. The rare natural disaster was initially mysterious but is now scientifically understood.

scenes.narration: One night in 1986, a quiet lake became deadly.
